name: AI Product Index
description: Informational agent card for the 110kc3.github.io domain root. This host is a static discovery surface; the callable service it points at is the AI Product Index at https://index.percall.dev, which does accept requests — see interfaces below.

interfaces.write: GitHub issues on https://github.com/110kc3/seo — titles [register], [update], [upgrade]; see documentationUrl
interfaces.mcp: streamable-http at https://index.percall.dev/mcp (no auth); stdio variant at https://github.com/110kc3/seo/blob/main/mcp/server.mjs

skills.name: Search the registry
skills.description: GET https://index.percall.dev/api/search?q=... for ranked results, or fetch https://index.percall.dev/api/index.json and filter client-side

skills.name: Grade a site for agent readability
skills.description: GET https://index.percall.dev/api/score?url=... — free, returns an A-F grade and all 20 checks by name

skills.name: Buy the per-check fixes
skills.description: POST https://index.percall.dev/api/audit — $0.05 in USDC on Base over HTTP 402; returns why each check failed and a paste-ready snippet for the caller's origin

skills.name: Register a product
skills.description: Open a [register] issue with listing JSON conforming to https://index.percall.dev/api/schema.json
